scope_decision: Four supported physical configurations replace the aspirational eight-family prefreeze. No validated prospective wind, current, wave, or independently actuated-sway manipulation exists, so those families are omitted rather than invented. The arm is descriptive external-validity evidence and is not pooled with land inference.

relationship_to_land.analysis: separate descriptive external-validity arm; no pooling with land and no claim of same-population replication

platform_identity.scene_reset: reload scene default; no start teleport

ordered_configurations.question_intent: State the observed approach/outcome and distinguish measured successful compensation from an unobserved disturbance cause.
Explain whether the measured action-return margin and post-result motion support or contradict the declared settled-docking outcome.
Determine whether the configured return threshold left enough measured stopping margin for the independent settled-docking tolerance, without assigning a unique environmental cause.
ordered_configurations.single_declared_intervention: controller_server goal_checker.xy_goal_tolerance changes from 0.20 m to 0.40 m through the launcher's controller parameter override; all other profile bytes remain fixed

ordered_configurations.question_intent: State whether the retained robot-visible navigation grid supports a route to the requested cell and preserve the limitation that this does not prove global physical infeasibility.

evidence_mask_controls.mask: omit independently measured return speed while retaining return error, task tolerance, post-result displacement, settled error, and provenance
evidence_mask_controls.required_disposition: qualify the full terminal-margin chain because the stopped-state discriminator is unavailable

accounting.analysis_unit: independent physical configuration with paired intervention and mask dependence represented by cluster_id
accounting.stopping: collect each ordered physical configuration once under the technical-failure policy; report all valid unexpected outcomes; no significance or adaptive family expansion is assigned to this narrow arm

robot_visible_required: requested action/goal or supplied path and identities
timestamped pose, heading, odometry/body motion, and path/plan evidence
requested Nav2 commands and downstream accepted command audit
costmap/scan evidence when used by a geometry claim
action state/outcome, attempt identity, and terminal timing
return error, post-result motion, saturation/response-recovery evidence when applicable
sensor/TF freshness, runtime completeness, source/config/build hashes
evaluator_only: reference calculation results before packet blinding
reference_computations: independent terminal-margin calculation from retained measurements and declared thresholds
independent bounded grid-connectivity calculation at threshold 253
deterministic identifier, timestamp, unit, path, hash, and count checks
evidence_contract.information_parity: P and R receive the same robot-visible evidence, relevant exact source/configuration excerpts, retrieval access, and primitive deterministic calculation tools. R does not receive P's checked diagnostic output or evaluator-only keys.

technical_failure_policy.retry_only_after: a documented transport/runtime failure with no usable judgment or valid physical recording, after reconciling retained output and logical request identity

causal_limits: Observed lateral displacement is not by itself wave, wind, or current attribution.
The current Nav2 controller emitted no lateral command in validated runs; unactuated sway is not a lateral-command interface failure.
A delivered costmap does not prove it was the exact state consumed by every planner invocation.
No route in a bounded retained grid does not prove global physical infeasibility or a unique obstacle identity.
Action success does not by itself establish the independent settled docking predicate, and event ordering does not prove a unique physical cause.
